_comment: Sources whose licence text was read (CI job tm-sources, log of each run) and allows redistribution inside a commercial app. Only these are built into app/src/main/assets/tm. Excluded and unresolved sources are listed with the reason; see docs/LICENSING.md.

tatoeba.attribution: Tatoeba (https://tatoeba.org) contributors; each pair names its sentence ids and authors
tatoeba.evidence: tatoeba.org/en/downloads: 'These files are released under CC BY 2.0 FR'; terms of use 6.2: CC-BY 2.0 FR default for text sentences, single condition attribution

kaikki.attribution: Wiktionary contributors (https://en.wiktionary.org), extracted with wiktextract / kaikki.org (Tatu Ylonen)
kaikki.evidence: Wiktionary text is CC BY-SA 4.0 (and GFDL); kaikki.org redistributes the extracted entries
kaikki.share_alike: the shipped tm/*.tsv files that contain Wiktionary rows are themselves CC BY-SA 4.0

oldi_seed.attribution: OLDI Seed, Open Language Data Initiative (https://oldi.org); NLLB Seed authors
oldi_seed.evidence: dataset card: 'licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0', 'expert-generated', 'intended to be used to kick-start machine translation models'; not gated
oldi_seed.share_alike: the corpus files that contain these rows are CC BY-SA 4.0

smol.evidence: dataset card: '## License This data is released under cc-by-4.0'; professional translations from English (SmolSent, SmolDoc; SmolDoc English sides were model-written, the translations are human)

flores.gate: Protecting the integrity of FLORES+ for evaluation: 'I agree not to re-host FLORES+ in places where it could be picked up by web crawlers'; 'If I evaluate using FLORES+, I will ensure that its contents are not in the training data'
flores.reason: the gate forbids re-hosting where crawlers can reach it; a public repository and a public APK would do that. Local evaluation only (docs/LOCAL_HF_SOURCES_PROMPT.md); never committed (data/tm-raw/flores is git-ignored)

doda.reason: LICENSE file: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0; README: commercial use only with the authors' permission

arzen-multigenre.reason: segments come from published song lyrics, novels and film subtitles whose copyright is not the dataset authors'; owner decision pending

padic.reason: licence page not reachable from CI (smart.loria.fr timed out, sourceforge 403)

lisan.reason: licence page not reachable from CI; word-level glosses only, no sentence translations

madar.reason: not allowed in a commercial app

nadi.reason: not allowed in a commercial app

lahga.reason: aggregates other lexicons and Wiktionary extracts; provenance of its examples must be checked first (job tm-sources prints samples)

medical-questionnaire.reason: card does not say who translated; samples printed by tm-sources for review

algerian-50k.reason: card states rows have no source id, licence or translator; origin cannot be verified

ibrahimamin-arz-en.reason: merge that includes ArzEn-MultiGenre subtitles; third-party copyright cannot be relicensed as MIT

synthetic-sets.reason: FREAD (GPT-4o), TinyStories-Algerian-Darija, tunis-ai MSA-Tunisian, Adaption, ArabCulture-Dialogue (GPT-5 drafts): machine-generated; Global PIQA forbids AI training

flores-copies.reason: ungated re-uploads of FLORES-200 (Muennighoff/flores200, mteb/flores, ...): would sidestep the OLDI request not to re-host it
